summary.text: Introduces the manual as a reference for WHO editors working in English, meant to keep language clear and terminology and symbols consistent, to be consulted in cases of doubt rather than applied rigidly. States that it is not a grammar or writing guide, names the unit that prepared it and invites comments.

sections.extract: ]. Introduction This style manual is intended primarily for use by WHO editors working in English. Its main purpose is to ensure that the language used in WHO publications is clear and correct and that the scientific and other special nomenclature and terminology, abbreviations and sym- bols are reasonably consistent and follow established international precedents.
